description: The introduction of generative AI led to a 17% decrease in job postings for automation-prone occupations and a 22% increase for augmentation-prone occupations.

instances.assertion: The introduction of generative AI led to a 17% decrease in job postings for automation-prone occupations and a 22% increase for augmentation-prone occupations.
The introduction of new technologies often leads to the creation of new tasks that 'reinstate' labor.
